en.headline: Three Disneyland lands to close early on 10 and 11 October
en.dek: The park's official calendar says Toy Story Land, Mystic Point and Grizzly Gulch will shut at 6:30pm those evenings for a private event.
body: Hong Kong Disneyland says three themed lands will close earlier than the rest of the park next weekend because of a private event.

A notice on the resort's official day calendar says Toy Story Land, Mystic Point and Grizzly Gulch will close at 6:30pm on 10 and 11 October. The park has not named the event. Other areas are not covered by that early-closing line.
The same calendar lists regular park hours as a guide only, and says schedules can change without notice. Live entertainment may also be altered or cancelled for operational reasons.
The resort is on Lantau. Visitors planning those two evenings would need to finish the three lands before 6:30pm, and check the day's schedule again closer to the date.

zh.headline: 迪士尼三個園區10月10及11日提早關閉
zh.dek: 樂園官方日曆顯示，反斗奇兵大本營、迷離莊園及灰熊山谷該兩晚6時30分關閉，原因是私人活動。
body: 香港迪士尼樂園表示，下周末有私人活動，三個主題園區會較園內其他範圍提早關閉。
度假區官方日曆的告示寫明，反斗奇兵大本營、迷離莊園及灰熊山谷將於10月10日及11日下午6時30分關閉。樂園沒有公布活動名稱。告示沒有把其他園區納入同一提早關閉安排。
同一日曆指，開放時間及節目時間只供參考，可在不另通知下更改。現場表演亦可能因運作安排而改期或取消。
樂園位於大嶼山。計劃該兩晚入園的遊人，須在下午6時30分前遊完上述三個園區，並在出發前再核對當日時間表。
